name: Higyaku no Youkan 2
source:
A western mansion in the woods is home to sadistic girls (some futanari).
This is the experience of one lost traveler who was slaved by them.
The game begins on the 2nd day of total sex training.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ096437?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
树林深处有一栋洋馆，住着一群以虐人为乐的女孩，其中有些是扶她。
一名迷路的旅人落入她们手里，成了她们的奴隶。这里讲的就是这名旅人的遭遇。
游戏从全方位性调教的第二天开始。
